summary: Chamath highlights that Rick's Cabaret stock has dropped ~25-30% recently, reviving the 'strip club recession index' as a potential leading indicator of an upcoming recession.
quote: The Rick's Cabaret recession index is back on. Did you guys see this?... the stock just you know, puked up like 25 or 30% in the last week.

summary: Friedberg argues the Rick's Cabaret stock decline is structural rather than cyclical, driven by OnlyFans pulling talent from the strip club industry, reducing product quality and thus revenue.
quote: OnlyFans took all the entertainers out of the strip club industry because they make more money online... the quality of the product at the cabaret business has declined, and as a result, revenue has declined.
